profile.headline: Software Engineer at Iradimed Corporation
profile.summary:
Highly motivated senior electrical engineer with extensive experience in designing, developing of the IC Verification/Validation tool, mix signal test. Knowledgeable of test creation, test plan coverage, test regressions, network programming. Multi-task, proven team player as well as autonomous.

Specialties: Languages: C, C++, Verilog HDL, Assembler, Perl, Tcl, C#, MatLab, HTML and MySql
Software:	UNIX, LINUX, MS Windows, MSVC, LabView
Hardware:	ATE, Palladium, Logic analyzer, Oscilloscope, Spectrum Analyzer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Bring up LDRA dynamic tests for Zilog / Renesas Microcontrollers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop firmware, application software for Microchip controller. 
•	Using LDRA to Automatically Generate & Manage Unit Test and System Integration Testing

positions.title: Design Validation Engineer
positions.description:
Analog Validation Engineer 2009 - 2014
Develop automation tools (C#, MatLab), validate analog modules of the high end automotive microcontrollers,  including: Analog to Digital converter, PLL jitter, ESD trigger, Power Management…

Senior Design Verification, Validation,   2005 - 2009
Provided support for functional verification and validation flows.  Duties included creation of functional tests, regression management, test plan creation, and defect analysis for CPG worldwide Chip Design Team.
•	Verified by using random stimulus along with functional coverage and assertion-based verification methodologies.
•	Validate mobile SOC IC, including ARM’s storage controller: NAND flash, SDHS, SSD…
•	Firmware development (High Assurance Boot). Port Linux RedBoot to ARM controller. 
•	Provided first line defect analysis of validation test failures on a weekly basis, resulting in more efficient design correction.
•	Managed 1,000+ test case suite and executed functional regression of module and core level test benches for a defect free gate design.
•	Designed, developed the regression tools for the Palladium emulation system. These tools were effectively using to port the verification tests to Palladium emulation system.
•	Designed, developed the Multi-core Validation Tool for post-silicon validation. These tools were famously worldwide for standardization and improving the validation process on EVB.  
•	Trained validation team members.
•	Design the common tools to port the System Verilog test bench tests to EVB test bench – from UNIX/LINUX environment to Windows environment.
•	Developed the USB driver for Windows.
•	Developed the AutoBench Validation Tool by using Xilinx cpld, fpga and LabView. These tools were successfully automated validation process on EVB by directly control the external instruments through GPIB and Ethernet communications and collecting data to Excel Spreadsheet and mySql database.

positions.title: Senior Test Engineer
positions.description: Provide test development on digital and mix signal ATE

positions.title: System Validation Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for innovating and improving the production equipments.
•	Developed the diagnostic software/hardware for the AD converter tester and T1 communication tester, these are in house build systems.
•	Created the diagnostic software/hardware for the new Flat Panel Tester.
•	Designed software/hardware of the impedance measurement system on VXI mainframe. This system help to quickly detecting the impedance mismatch of a large pogo ring.
•	Designed and developed a very famous backup system for Eagle tester and Blue Box system which were running on Windows 3.1 operating system. This software will be automatic removing unknown files on hard drives or backing up the hard drives when system scratched. This simple tool was a major improving the up time for test-floor production in that time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed a remote control system, operated by solar panel for oil industry.
•	Developed the RTOS on the MC68332.
•	Using Borland C++ to develop the API program on Windows to control remotely the pipe line valve system, by using the GPS transceiver system.
